title: John Woo Presents Stranglehold (PS3, BLUS30081)
notes: Precision Aim (the bullet-cam shot) found by static analysis of CookedPS3/StrangleholdGame.xxx with gbox.ue3. The shot is a StrangleholdProjectile_Bullet_PrecisionAim (damage class StrangleholdDamageType_Bullet_PrecisionAim). On impact the native projectile calls the script event ResolvePrecisionAim(InImpactedActor), which picks the hit cinema (target is a StrangleholdPawn) or PrecisionAimMissTrigger; damage then goes through StrangleholdPawn.ServerResolveDamage, whose precision-aim branch sets DamageScale=1000 (lethal) for non-boss targets before CauseDamageToSelf. Edits are same-length bytecode rewrites (JumpIfNot -> Jump) applied in live RAM and reverted after the shot.
